package.description: Update firmware for Victron products that are updateable via a VE.Can communication port.

en-US.description: Update firmware for Victron products that are updateable via a VE.Can communication port.
en-US.longDescription:
Use this to update firmware for Victron products that are updateable via a VE.Can communication port. These are:
- BlueSolar Chargers 150/70 and 150/85
- Lynx Shunt VE.Can
- All four Skylla-i battery chargers
- All our different VE.Can and NMEA2000 interfaces
- Ion Control
en-US.name: VE Power Setup

zh-CN.description: 通过 VE.Can 通信端口更新可升级的 Victron 产品的固件。
zh-CN.longDescription:
使用此工具通过 VE.Can 通信端口为可升级的 Victron 产品更新固件。适用于以下设备：
- BlueSolar 充电器 150/70 和 150/85
- Lynx Shunt VE.Can
- 全部四款 Skylla-i 电池充电器
- 我们所有不同类型的 VE.Can 和 NMEA2000 接口
- Ion Control
